hook_candidates.headline: SPACEX'S SATELLITE OUTPOWERS THE ENTIRE SPACE STATION
SPACEX JUST PUT AN AI SUPERCOMPUTER IN ORBIT
SPACEX JUST MOVED AI ABOVE ANY GOVERNMENT'S REACH
SPACEX BUILT AN AI SATELLITE BIGGER THAN A 747
ONE SPACEX SATELLITE NOW BEATS THE ENTIRE SPACE STATION

caption:
Each SpaceX AI1 satellite will outpower the entire International Space Station, and there's a fleet of them coming.

SpaceX's AI1 satellites will each generate over 250kW of solar power, 20% more than the entire ISS, which took 16 countries and 30 years to build. These aren't communication satellites. They're orbital AI supercomputers. The newest one is 75 meters wide, bigger than a 747. The AI that might replace your job is being sent to orbit.

AI computing has moved from data centers to orbit. SpaceX owns the rockets, the satellites, and now the AI fleet, putting a computing network no single country can shut down beyond any government's reach.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this shift means for you.

Sources: Elon Musk on X

#SpaceX #AI #Starlink #Space #Technology
